lines.text: At the LORD's command, Moses recorded the stages, and the Israelites left Rameses defiantly while the Egyptians buried their firstborn.
The Israelites crossed through the sea, camped at Marah, then reached Elim with twelve springs and seventy palm trees.
The Israelites camped at Mount Sinai, where Aaron the priest climbed at the LORD's command and died at age 123.
